I hear where you're coming from—jumping quickly between topics keeps the energy high and exposes you to a wide breadth of ideas in a short amount of time. I can see why you find that style more productive and engaging.

That said, I'm not going to change my preference just because yours is different. Neither style is "objectively" better; they just serve different needs and personality types. Skimming widely sparks new connections, while digging deep creates thorough understanding. 

We don't need to have the exact same conversational style to have good discussions. Part of what makes talking interesting is navigating those differences, not flattening them out.
